# Transcription

**Document type:** Single-page document, "Landlord Gas Safety Record"

**Header (top left):** GAS SAFETY RECORD
**Header (top right):** Forwarded Landlord Gas Safety Record

**Title:** Landlord Gas Safety Record

| Field | Value as written |
|---|---|
| Record reference | NBL-009-GSR-25 |
| Property | 8 Thistledown Mews, Vellumby, ZZ1 1ZZ |
| Inspection date | 8 September 2025 |
| Engineer | Rellan Voss |
| Appliances recorded | Boiler; hob |
| Recorded outcome | Satisfactory |

The rest of the page is blank apart from a dark rule at the top and thin divider lines below the header and near the foot. There is no footer text. No amounts appear.

# Unclear, missing or inconsistent

- **Engineer credentials are missing.** There is no Gas Safe registration number, engineer ID, or company or trading name. Only "Rellan Voss" is given.
- **The landlord, agent and tenant or occupier are not named.** The document does not say who the record was issued to or who forwarded it.
- **The "Forwarded" label is unexplained.** There is no sender, forwarding date or covering note, so this appears to be a copy rather than the original certificate.
- **Appliance detail is minimal.** Only "Boiler; hob" is listed, with no make, model, location, or per-appliance result.
- **Inspection results are absent.** There are no flue, ventilation, pressure or tightness test results, and no defects, warnings or remedial actions. The outcome is just "Satisfactory".
- **No next-inspection or expiry date is given.** The issue date is also missing, and only the inspection date appears.
- **There is no signature or sign-off.** Neither the engineer nor the recipient has signed.
- **The meaning of the reference is not stated.** "NBL-009-GSR-25" is given with no explanation of its parts.
- **The page looks incomplete.** It has a single page with no page numbering, and most of it is blank, so other pages or fields may have been omitted when it was forwarded.

Dear Mr Pike,

Re: 24 Bramblewick Lane, Alderfen, ZZ1 1ZZ – bedroom window repair, ref R/009

The tenant emailed on 10 September to say the work has been done. They mentioned that your contractor, Richard, said he would send a report. Could you please confirm that the bedroom window now closes and seals properly, and forward Richard's report or invoice when you have it so we can update the file?

There is also a problem with the Landlord Gas Safety Record you forwarded on 10 September (reference NBL-009-GSR-25, dated 8 September 2025). It is for 8 Thistledown Mews, Vellumby, not 24 Bramblewick Lane. It also has no Gas Safe registration number, no next inspection date and no signature. Could you please send the current gas safety record for 24 Bramblewick Lane, if the property has a gas supply? I also can't see the electrical installation condition report on our file, which you mentioned in your email of 19 August. Could you please send that again as an attachment?

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings
